title: AIR CONDITIONING-CONTROL ASM. WIRING & VACUUM HOSE ASM.
summary: Air conditioning (C60) heater/A/C control head in the console: the control assembly with its temperature cable to the valve on the heater case, the color-striped vacuum hose harness to the actuators (outside-air diaphragm, water valve, heater, de-ice, A/C, defog), the switch, and the instrument panel harness and connector. The vacuum switch terminal is held by a screw (with M40 automatic), another screw holds hardware at the side of the control, and a clip retains the vacuum hose at the defroster vacuum actuator.

parts.name: CONTROL ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Control assembly – A/C heater control head

parts.name: HOSE ASM.-VAC CONTROL
parts.name_expanded: Hose assembly – vacuum control harness (color-striped hoses)

parts.name: CLIP
parts.name_expanded: Clip – vacuum hose at defroster actuator

fastening.note: Screw [1] goes through the production terminal into the vacuum switch on the side of the control (RPO M40 cars).

fastening.to: bracket on the right side of the control asm.
fastening.note: Screw [5] goes into the right-hand side of the control asm. at the vacuum valve / hose connector area.

fastening.to: control asm. [2] and the temperature valve at the heater case
fastening.note: Temperature cable [3] is held at the control by a production nut and runs to the valve on the left of the heater/evaporator case.
Vacuum hose asm. [8] plugs onto the control's vacuum valve; individual hoses go to the actuators per the stripe chart.
Clip [9] at the vacuum actuator (top center). For clip installation see plenum valve sheet (note A).
Connector [6] joins the 14 ga brown lead near the control; harness [7] runs along the A/C harness.

notes: NOTE: Defroster valve must return to free position within ± .25 at defroster valve tip when vacuum is vented.
A: For clip inst see plenum valve sheet.
